author: Bigbuttseeker
quote: People are really out here review-bombing the Zelda OoT remake just because GTA 6 flopped with some lame "Perfect Boyfriend Simulator" story where you buy Lucia a necklace, pick her up from work, and grab groceries. GTA 6 is sitting at a 5.5 with 45k reviews right now, and Zelda dropped from a 9.6 to a 9.1 in a single day over it. The map is good, the foundation of GTA is still there, but its filled with cringy Borderlands 3/4 millennia  cringy type writing, constant LGBTQ representation and literal invincibility protection in-game, and just boring characters, there is no Trever, Lemar, or Brucy type character in this game.
